article.title: When each legatee compellable to refund in proportion.
article.content: When the executor or administrator has paid away the assets in legacies, and he is afterwards obliged to discharge a debt of which he had no previous notice, he is entitled to call upon each legatee to refund in proportion.
article.html:
359When each legatee compellable to refund in proportion.

Section 359 · Part IX · Chapter XII · page 90 of the Act

When the executor or administrator has paid away the assets in legacies, and he is afterwards obliged to discharge a debt of which he had no previous notice, he is entitled to call upon each legatee to refund in proportion.
